## Native / Tauri

Before touching anything under `src-tauri/` (Rust commands, JNI, Android keychain, biometrics, mobile builds), read [docs/TAURI-ANDROID-GUIDE.md](docs/TAURI-ANDROID-GUIDE.md). It explains the Tauri 2 layout and the only supported way to get the Android JVM/Context.
